clips.title: The story
paras: Skilled Alliance medics are called to Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh. Instructors across Alliance capitals send accomplished practitioners to study under Doctor Gustaf VanHowzen, chief physician of the Alliance's elite medical corps.

When you master the healing methods taught in the great Alliance cities, local instructors have little more to teach. Those with exceptional skill in needle, cloth, and triage are brought to Doctor Gustaf VanHowzen's attention. He works from Theramore Isle, where Alliance Trauma tends the wounded in Kalimdor's fiercest warzones and beyond.

Nissa Firestone in Ironforge treats VanHowzen's personal summons as a rare privilege. Theramore Isle faces regional threats, skirmishes, and harsh wilderness, so grievously wounded soldiers arrive steadily. You travel across the sea to Dustwallow Marsh to reach VanHowzen's clinic, where he tests how calmly battlefield surgeons can assess the wounded.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Doctor friend, I presume. It is a pleasure to see you.

I have some wonderful news for you! Gustaf VanHowzen, chief physician of Alliance Trauma has made a personal request for you to join him at Theramore. This could be the opportunity of a lifetime! I would give anything to be given a chance to study under the great doctor, Gustaf VanHowzen! Do not squander this opportunity, doctor!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Wonderful. Put on your scrubs, we are to start at once!
